name: queries/services/__init__.py
summary: Package initialization module that aggregates and exposes QueryService and CacheService as the public API for the queries services layer
purpose: Simplifies imports for consumers by providing a single entry point to the services package, decoupling internal module organization from external usage and establishing a clear public interface
responsibilities: Re-export QueryService and CacheService from internal submodules
Define the public API surface of the queries.services package
Shield consumers from internal file organization changes
architecture_notes: Implements the Facade and Aggregate Root patterns for package-level API design. By centralizing exports in __init__.py, the module enforces information hiding and loose coupling between internal service implementations and their consumers. This follows Python's convention for package-level public interfaces and supports clean import statements (e.g., from queries.services import QueryService).
improvements: Add __all__ explicit export list to prevent accidental namespace pollution and clarify the public contract
Consider lazy imports if service classes are heavy to reduce startup time
Add type hints or protocol definitions if consumers depend on abstract interfaces rather than concrete implementations
